title: MInfoVisQA: A Multilingual Benchmark for Information-Rich Visual Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.21644v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel in vision-language tasks; yet, whether they maintain consistent understanding of information-rich visuals (InfoVis) when the surface language changes remains unclear. To quantify this capability, we introduce MInfoVisQA, a parallel benchmark with 8,960 QA configurations derived from 128 seed instances across 24 languages. We construct seed-matched, language-parallel visuals and QA pairs by disentangling numerical-structural data from text and programmatically synchronizing translated labels. We evaluate 25 MLLMs under two settings: Language-Aligned QA (LQA, matching visual-text languages) and Cross-Language QA (XQA, fixed QA language with varying visual languages). The results show that aggregate accuracy masks substantial robustness gaps: two models with comparable mean LQA accuracy (80.4\%) exhibit performance spreads of 7.8 and 20.3 percentage points across languages. translated_title: MInfoVisQA：面向信息丰富型视觉问答的多语言基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉-语言任务中表现出色；然而，当表面语言发生变化时，它们能否对信息丰富的可视化保持一致的理解仍不清楚。为了量化这一能力，我们提出了 MInfoVisQA，这是一个包含 8,960 个问答配置的平行基准，这些配置源自 24 种语言中的 128 个种子实例。我们通过将数值结构数据与文本解耦并以编程方式同步翻译后的标签，构建了种子匹配、语言平行的可视化与问答对。我们在两种设置下评估了 25 个多模态大语言模型：语言对齐问答（LQA，视觉与文本语言匹配）和跨语言问答（XQA，固定问答语言而视觉语言变化）。结果表明，总体准确率掩盖了巨大的鲁棒性差距：两个平均 LQA 准确率相当（均为 80.4%）的模型，在不同语言间的性能波动分别为 7.8 和 20.3 个百分点。此外，所有 25 个多模态大语言模型……
tldr: 该论文提出了 MInfoVisQA——一个涵盖 24 种语言、8,960 个问答配置的信息丰富型视觉问答多语言基准，评估揭示了多模态大语言模型在不同语言间存在显著的鲁棒性差距，总体准确率掩盖了性能波动。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MInfoVisQA, a multilingual benchmark with 8,960 QA configurations across 24 languages for information-rich visual question answering, revealing that aggregate accuracy masks substantial cross-language robustness gaps in multimodal LLMs.
